subject: Onboarding sprint planning: owners, success criteria, security & procurement
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@quadrant.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed onboarding sprint kickoff windows (Quadrant)

Hi Alex —

Great to meet last week. Wed like to get a 60-minute onboarding sprint to align owners, define success criteria, and map out a 4-week trial timeline for the trial you requested. Suggested windows (US PT):

- Tue Aug 11: 09:00 - 10:00 or 10:00 - 11:00
- Wed Aug 12: 13:00 - 14:00
- Mon Aug 16: 11:00 - 12:00

Attendees we recommend: AE (me), SE (Dylan), CSM (Neha), Quadrant eng lead, Quadrant procurement/security as needed.

Attached: success_criteria_v1.docx (draft). If you can confirm preferred slots and who from your side should join (security/procurement), well lock the invite and circulate a short mutual action plan.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding sprint kickoff windows (Quadrant)

Thanks Ben —

Appreciate the options. Aug 11 looks promising for our eng lead and security. Can we do Tue Aug 11, 10:00 - 11:00 PT? Ill loop in Maria (security) and procurement so they can confirm. A couple quick asks from our side before we lock:

- Can you share a short list of security pre-reqs (network/IP allowlist, data handling notes)?
- Who will own the mutual action plan on Redwoods side?

Procurement: procurement@quadrant.io (internal contact).

Thanks — Ill confirm after Maria checks her calendar.

— Alex

Senior Cloud Engineer, Quadrant Systems
alex.ramirez@quadrant.io

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@quadrant.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@quadrant.io>, procurement@quadrant.io
Date: 2026-08-02T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding sprint kickoff windows (Quadrant)

Thanks Alex — putting this in Nehas inbox to coordinate timing and owners.

Confirming: Tue Aug 11, 10:00 - 11:00 PT is tentatively preferred (pending Maria/procurement).

Draft owners and immediate asks:

- Mutual action plan owner (Redwood): Neha Kapoor (CSM) — I will maintain the MAP and update the shared sheet.
- AE owner: Ben Carter (commercial owner)
- SE owner: Dylan Brooks (technical lead for the sprint & demo)
- Security contact (Quadrant): Maria Lopez (cc'd)
- Procurement contact (Quadrant): procurement@quadrant.io (cc'd)

Proposed success criteria for the 60-minute sprint (short list to confirm):
- Demo of integration flow with a sample dataset or mocked payloads
- Baseline latency/throughput expectations documented
- Security gating checklist reviewed (network, token handling, retention)
- Agreement on trial timeline and next milestones (MVP tests, acceptance)

Ive uploaded a working MAP and the criteria doc here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFG-success-criteria (view-only for Quadrant). Ill attach a formal MAP (mutual_action_plan_QDR-2026-041.xlsx) after this thread.

Can Maria confirm availability and if there are any network/IP allowlist requirements we should publish before the sprint? @Dev — can you paste the short network checklist in a reply?

Agenda (60 minutes):
1) Intros and roles (5m)
2) High-level architecture and demo (20m)
3) Test/trial plan and acceptance criteria (20m)
4) Security/procurement gating and next steps (10m)

If you confirm, Ill produce the MAP and send calendar invites with the doc links.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

Attachments (to follow): mutual_action_plan_QDR-2026-041.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding sprint kickoff windows (Quadrant)

Neha / Alex —

Aug 11, 10:00 PT works for me. Quick technical notes Ill cover during the sprint and items to prepare beforehand:

- I will need a test API key or a read-only test account for Quadrant so I can demonstrate a sample end-to-end request. If you prefer, we can use a mocked payload (either works for the demo).
- If Quadrant wants the service to reach into a private network, we will need an IP allowlist. Minimal network requirements are in the attached PDF.
- Can Quadrant provide a small sample payload (JSON) and which model/throughput envelope youd like us to validate?

Attached: network_requirements.pdf (stub).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Dylan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com

All —

Thanks for the quick replies. Confirming the plan:

- Meeting scheduled: Tue Aug 11, 2026 | 10:00 - 11:00 PT (60 min)
- Calendar invite will be sent to this thread's participants. Neha will own the MAP and follow-ups; Dylan will lead the demo.
- Neha: please add the Drive link and MAP (when ready).
- Alex / Maria / Procurement: please send the sample payload and any IPs to allowlist by EOD Aug 6 so Dylan has time to prepare.

HubSpot deal (for internal reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/QDR-2026-041

Attaching a calendar invite stub (calendar_invite.ics) and Ill add the invite once Maria confirms.

Cheers,
